title: 3D-UNet-BraTS2021-Segmentation: Multi-Region Brain Tumor Segmentation Using a Compact 3D U-Net on the BraTS 2021 Dataset Under a 6 GB Memory Budget
description: Compact 3D U-Net for automatic multi-region brain tumor segmentation (whole tumor, tumor core, enhancing tumor), trained and evaluated on the BraTS 2021 dataset (1251 multimodal MRI cases: T1, contrast-enhanced T1, T2, FLAIR) under a 6 GB consumer-grade GPU memory budget.
